customRendering.description: Append a timestamp/step/duration footer to tool results. Default true.

agentTemperatures.description: Sampling temperature per agent, keyed by exact agent name such as "Worker".

agentConcurrency.description: Concurrent delegated tasks per agent, keyed by exact agent name. 0 means unlimited.

defaultConcurrency.description: Concurrent delegated tasks for agents without their own limit. Default 10; 0 means unlimited.

acquisitionTimeoutMs.description: How long a delegated task may wait for a free slot, in milliseconds. Default 300000.

contextMaxTokens.description: Context window to assume for every model. Unset uses the limit the host reports.

missionLoop.description: Mission ledger and markdown memory settings.
